| # DIDs for Discovery App Communication {#dids-for-discovery-app-communication-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                            |                                                                                                                                                  |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Discovery App identifies the electronic devices that can be flashed and diagnosed by BODAS-service 4.x.

It is developed and delivered by Bosch Rexroth.

 

The table below lists the Data Identifiers (DIDs) relevant to Discovery App communication for RC18-12/40 or RC27-18/40, along with their associated functions and usage contexts.

### Note: {#note .p_Heading3 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- The DIDs are accessible within the Default diagnostic session without requiring any specific security access.

- These DIDs are read-only and cannot be modified or written to.

 

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"}   ODX-UUID shall be unique for every BODAS-service App due to BODAS-app Concept and 16 bytes long.
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The usage of the DIDs are described below:

  -------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------
  DID      USE                                                                                                                                                                                                                               MNEMONIC
  0xF18A   SystemSupplierIdentifier: This value shall be used to reference the system supplier name and address information. Record data content and format shall be server specific and defined by the system supplier.                     SSIDDID
  0xF18C   ECUSerialNumberDataIdentifier: This value shall be used to reference the ECU(serial number).Record data content and format shall be server specific.                                                                              ECUSNDID
  0xF192   SystemSupplierECUHardwareNumberIdentifier: This value shall be used to reference the system supplier specific ECU(hardware number). Record data content and format shall be server specific and defined by the system supplier.   SSECUHWNDID
  0xF19E   ODXFileDataIdentifier: This value shall be used to reference the ODX (Open Diagnostic Data Exchange) file of the server to be used to interprete and scale the server data.                                                       ODXFDID
  -------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------
